description: Ground boxes that switch an NPC's collision sets while it stands inside them. Each zone: maps (map type tags of config/map_info.json), min_x / max_x / min_z / max_z (inclusive bounds in Q12 metres as raw integers: 191.6 m = 784793), clear and set (collision set names: Map, Objects, AltObjects, Unused3). The town has two such spots, where the object collisions give way to the alternative set. A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.
